name: What does 'outdated-room modernization' entail?
description: It's updating a room's look, function, and infrastructure to modern standards for better comfort and efficiency.

acceptedAnswer.text: Outdated-room modernization involves updating the aesthetics, functionality, and often the infrastructure of a room to meet contemporary standards and your specific needs. This can include reconfiguring layouts, upgrading electrical systems, replacing fixtures, installing new flooring, and improving insulation. The goal is to enhance comfort, energy efficiency, and overall living quality within the existing space, without necessarily expanding the room's footprint.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's updating a room's look, function, and infrastructure to modern standards for better comfort and efficiency.
